verdict.rationale: There is evidence of third-party integrations and tools (Cursor, Trae.ai, OpenRouter, Composer 2.5, Google Cloud Vertex AI, Microsoft Foundry) showing Grok is plugged into some external tooling, but community commentary explicitly notes much lower adoption ('order of magnitude less OpenRouter usage than Claude, GPT, even Gemini') and no evidence of curated community lists, independent routers, or actively maintained third-party ecosystem projects specifically built around Grok. Missing for 10: curated 'awesome-grok' style lists, evidence of independent router/tooling projects with active maintainers, and broader third-party ecosystem adoption comparable to competitors.
